description: Defines the CommandProcessingResult class which encapsulates the result of processing a command in the Fineract core API, including identifiers, change data, and external IDs.

classes.name: CommandProcessingResult
classes.description: Represents the successful result of a REST API call that processes a command, including identifiers, change data, and external IDs.

methods.name: fromCommandProcessingResult
methods.description: Creates a new CommandProcessingResult from an existing one, optionally replacing the resourceId.

methods.name: fromDetails
methods.description: Constructs a CommandProcessingResult with detailed identifiers and data.

methods.name: commandOnlyResult
methods.description: Creates a result containing only a commandId.

methods.name: resourceResult
methods.description: Creates a result with resourceId, commandId, and optional changes.

methods.name: withChanges
methods.description: Creates a result with resourceId and changes.

methods.name: setOfficeId
methods.description: Sets the officeId for the result.

methods.name: getChanges
methods.description: Returns the changes map if not empty.

methods.name: hasChanges
methods.description: Indicates whether there are any changes.

methods.name: setExternalIdOrNull
methods.description: Returns null if ExternalId is empty, otherwise returns the ExternalId.
